approval_record.directive: Approve the preferred deterministic S-012 replacement route.

scope.route_owner: S-012 lean_worker under root Program Director acceptance
scope.comparison_rule: absolute deterministic agreement plus fixed arithmetic-precision and exponential-age-tail refinement under CONTRACT 7.1

isolation.applies_to: the entire deterministic numerical module, including second-order and passive-fourth routes
isolation.excluded_hash_recording_rule: copy the prior pilot and attempt SHA-256 literals from this plan into provenance; neither numerical module nor runner may open or hash an old stochastic artifact

passive_fourth_route.complete_reset_rule: subtract rho times each nonconstant moment because S=P=Q=0 immediately after PVTheta reset

regenerative_quadrature.parameter_conversion: exact rational strings converted directly to mpmath values inside the active precision context
regenerative_quadrature.matrix_exponential_action: compute exp(B*T) applied to the fixed augmented initial state through mpmath.expm; no time-step discretization is used

infinite_horizon_check.role: mandatory internal tail-remainder and numerical-conditioning check; not claimed as an independent scientific route
infinite_horizon_check.tail_remainder_raw_components: abs(J_dps80_rhoT80-m_infinity) for every raw second-order and passive-closure component
infinite_horizon_check.tail_remainder_output_space: abs(g(J_dps80_rhoT80)-g(m_infinity)) evaluated separately for every derived or gating output g, explicitly including centered_spatial_variance and raw_radial_excess_kurtosis_K=S2/(2*S^2)-1
requirements: condition number is finite and positive
every raw-component and output-space finest-cell tail remainder is <=1e-12

reference_route.derivation: T-012 exact stationary component hierarchy, closest-source radial checks, and passive fourth-moment law
reference_route.evaluation: substitute exact rational M, Pe, and rho; evaluate with sympy.N at 90 decimal digits; convert through a decimal string inside the comparison precision context

classification.scientific_numeric_serialization: finite decimal strings with 50 significant digits; no binary JSON floats for scientific values, discrepancies, residuals, or conditioning quantities
classification.precision_difference: abs(S_dps80-S_dps50) at each fixed scaled horizon
classification.tail_horizon_difference: abs(S_rhoT80-S_rhoT64) at each fixed arithmetic precision
classification.validated: all four cell errors, both precision differences, both tail-horizon differences, and every applicable raw-component and output-space finest-cell infinite-horizon tail remainder are <=1e-12 and the forward-error bound is <=1e-40
classification.contradicted: all four cell errors are >1e-12 while every precision and tail-horizon difference and every applicable raw-component and output-space finest-cell infinite-horizon tail remainder are <=1e-12 and the forward-error bound is <=1e-40
classification.invariant_rule: constant and orientation-norm values use references 1 and every declared symmetry-zero uses reference 0; each is classified by the same four-cell rule
classification.cross_closure_rule: for S, P, and Q, all four absolute differences between the passive closure and matching 28-state cell must be <=1e-12; any failure is BL2 and stops before scientific classification
classification.residual_validated: every fixed-cell stationary residual is <=1e-12 and every dps80 resolvent forward-error bound is <=1e-40
classification.overall: after all cross-closure checks pass the BL2 precondition, contradicted if any reference comparison is contradicted; otherwise unresolved if any comparison, invariant, residual, or limit-support trend is unresolved; validated only if every required item validates or passes

rare_reset.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/rhoT80 deterministic output; uncertainty not applicable
rare_reset.acceptance: after every underlying reference comparison validates, absolute discrepancy from each approached law decreases strictly along the sequence

frequent_reset.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/rhoT80 deterministic output; uncertainty not applicable
frequent_reset.acceptance: after every underlying reference comparison validates, absolute discrepancy from each approached law decreases strictly along the sequence

overdamped_position_support.estimator_and_uncertainty: dps80/rhoT80 deterministic output; uncertainty not applicable
overdamped_position_support.acceptance: after every underlying reference comparison validates, absolute discrepancy from each approached law decreases strictly along the sequence
overdamped_position_support.claim: finite numerical support only; the exact singular-limit interpretation remains in the contract and T-012

independence.basis_for_material_independence: hand-coded direct time-domain Ito moment ODE and exponential-age accumulator versus T-012 symbolic stationary hierarchy and closed source formulas
independence.supporting_internal_check_not_claimed_in: a stationary linear-system residual or resolvent check of the hand-coded ODE is an invariant only, not a second independent route

execution_controls.strict_json_loader: reject duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, non-object roots, and nonfinite values nested at any depth
execution_controls.plan_semantic_lock: the runner must hardcode the expected SHA-256 of the canonical semantics of this exact preregistered plan; every plan field is semantic and any mutation fails validation
execution_controls.canonical_semantics: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false
execution_controls.validate_mode: may validate plan, imports, source manifest, paths, and synthetic numerical fixtures but must not evaluate the canonical parameter grid or create canonical artifacts
execution_controls.canonical_output_precondition: the canonical output path must be absent before execution

source_commit_policy: execute only from a clean committed implementation and record that full commit SHA
publication_policy: atomically create the canonical output once and never overwrite it

stop_rules.bl2: stop before classification on provenance, basis, nonfinite, exact-rational parsing, matrix construction, old-artifact access, import isolation, cross-closure, strict-plan-lock, or reference-evaluation failure
stop_rules.bl3: a converged T-012 disagreement is contradicted; do not change formulas, grid, precision, horizon, or tolerance
stop_rules.unresolved: failed precision refinement, tail refinement, residual, or limit-support trend is unresolved
stop_rules.prior_evidence: do not read, pool, reclassify, or use any stochastic pilot value in the deterministic calculation
stop_rules.rerun: do not rerun, retry, top up, or write an alternate canonical result
stop_rules.revision: any change requires a new versioned preregistration before another execution
